thread.title: Stock Market Mixed, But Retailers Lululemon, Ulta Beauty Hit New Highs

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Stock Market Mixed, But Retailers Lululemon, Ulta Beauty Hit New Highs
text:
The stock market looked to end the week Friday with modestly positive action amid increasing trade tensions. Friday marks the deadline for Canada to sign on to the U.S.-Mexico trade deal struck Wednesday. Leaderboard name and IBD 50 stock Lululemon Athletica ( LULU ) soared to a new high with a more-than-14% advance after its better-than-expected Q2 results late Thursday. Meanwhile, Ulta Beauty ( ULTA ) is trying to stage a breakout past a potential buy point. ( For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today .)
X
The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite led the day's gains with a 0.3% rise. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 and Dow Jones industrial average lagged with increases of about 0.1% each.
Among the Dow stocks, Apple ( AAPL ) stock was one of the day's top performers, moving up over 1% and extending a win streak to eight trading sessions. Shares are about 17% above a recent flat base's 194.30 entry.
On the downside, energy component Chevron ( CVX ) gave up 1%. The stock is heading to multimonth lows and is below its 50- and 200-day moving average lines.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Among companies reporting earnings , Lululemon crushed the Street's earnings and sales targets late Thursday, sparking a 14% gain in early morning trade. Shares hit a new high after a successful test of the 50-day line in early August.
Ulta Beauty moved up almost 7% despite weaker-than-expected same-store sales growth. Meanwhile, Q3 profit guidance was lighter than expected. The cosmetics stock is breaking out above a flat base's 261.50 buy point, according to MarketSmith chart analysis. Shares are in the 5% buy range that tops out at 274.58.
These Recent Breakouts Are Mostly Positive Among recent breakouts, these top stocks are mostly showing progress after moves above flat-base buy points . Vertex Pharmaceuticals ( VRTX ) is trading just above a 183.49 flat-base entry after Wednesday's breakout. The stock dipped 0.2% Friday.
PayPal ( PYPL ) is battling to regain its flat base's 92.45 buy point after Wednesday's breakout. Shares moved up 0.1% and are right under the buy point.
ServiceNow ( NOW ) is about 2% above a 194.91 flat-base entry. The stock edged lower in morning trade.
F5 Networks ( FFIV ) on Thursday snapped a nine-day win streak that had carried the stock above a 183.37 buy point. F5 stock moved up 0.2% Friday and is just 1% off its recent highs.
Deckers Outdoor ( DECK ) is treading water at its 50-day line after a breakout above a 123.08 buy point sputtered. Shares are about 3% below the entry. A potential flaw is the stock's lagging relative strength line .
Inside The IBD 50 Among the top growth stocks , Align Technology ( ALGN ) edged lower in early trade. The stock tentatively broke out above a flat base's 385.10 buy point on Aug. 28 but still continues to make new highs. Shares are in the 5% buy range.
